verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own page documents in-app Copilot that gives insights into your public and private repositories in natural language (docs-6). It also documents Copilot code review that analyzes your pull requests and suggests improvements from your phone (docs-4, docs-10), with suggested changes you can apply (docs-25). missing for 10: in-depth mobile-specific documentation beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration of Copilot insights in the mobile app.
